title: Starting Web Apps While Stuck in Barton Hall, Sleeping in the Closet, & The Chickenshit Report
description: Remaining stuck on Level 2 in Barton Hall because moving to Cantor Hall requires earning Level 3, Katie and Nate start the Web Applications Developer course using personal laptops alongside middle-aged classmates Tina, Jim, and Sheila, shut down front-desk staffer Mr. Vance with signed yellow Hall Passes, survive a violent afternoon in the therapeutic pool, get caught sleeping together in a closet at the 11:00 PM bed check and call the staffer's bluff over butt-in-seats funding, and confront the duty supervisor over the morning 'Chickenshit Report.'
